analysis_definitions.establishment: first checkpoint with full-support R<0.1, center accuracy>0.9, and layer-6 linear accuracy>0.9
analysis_definitions.onset: first probe checkpoint with full-support R<0.9 and layer-6 linear accuracy>0.5, with both conditions retained at the next probe checkpoint
analysis_definitions.terminal_onset_rule: 10M cannot initiate onset because no next registered probe checkpoint exists to verify retention; no onset is coded as ordinal 8

metric_definitions.mean_pairwise_gradient_cosine: mean over all unordered pairs of per-batch unit gradient vectors
